en_title: Physical 'Copies' of GTA 6 Will Expire 170 Days After Launch Date in Japan
subtitle: 盒中没有光盘

paragraphs.en: If you’re buying ‘physical’ copies of GTA 6 in Japan, you’d better act fast and download that code lickety-split, else it might expire while you’re not looking.
paragraphs.cn: 若你在日本购买《GTA6》的「实体版」，最好尽快兑换下载码，否则它可能在你没留意时过期。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar already ruffled some feathers after revealing that ‘physical’ copies of Grand Theft Auto 6 would be that in name only. You get a cool box, but a disc won’t be inside it; instead, you’ll get a digital download code, which, in some regions, will expire after a certain period of time has passed.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar此前透露，《GTA6》的「实体版」只是名义上的实体版，引发不满。盒子很酷，但里面没有光盘，只有数字下载码；在部分地区，该码会在一段时间后失效。

paragraphs.en: As spotted by Power Unlimited columnist ‘Genki,’ Rockstar’s official website states that physical editions of the game will expire in Japan 170 days after launch on November 19th, 2026, due to “regional regulations.”
paragraphs.cn: Power Unlimited专栏作者Genki发现，Rockstar官网称，受「地区法规」影响，这款游戏在日本的实体版将于2026年11月19日发售后170天失效。

paragraphs.en: UPDATE: It has been confirmed that in Japan the Grand Theft Auto VI physical version download code in a box WILL expire after 170 days due to regional regulations!
paragraphs.cn: 更新：已确认在日本，盒装《GTA6》实体版的下载码会因地区法规在170天后失效。

paragraphs.en: The reason is the Japan “Payment Services Act” that states companies selling prepaid payments must register and… https://t.co/pwDjh8yvfG pic.twitter.com/TJVpiP04kc
paragraphs.cn: 原因是日本《支付服务法》规定，销售预付支付产品的公司必须登记并……

paragraphs.en: While there was some initial confusion as to whether or not this only applied to separate codes for DLC content, it has since been confirmed that yes, the actual GTA 6 product code will expire if not claimed after 170 days within Japan.
paragraphs.cn: 起初有人不确定这是否只适用于DLC内容的单独代码；如今已确认，在日本若170天内未兑换，《GTA6》游戏本体代码也会失效。

paragraphs.en: Genki cited Japan’s Payment Services Act as the reason for this. It’s a strict law that aims to protect consumers from getting scammed, requiring sellers of digital codes to set aside large amounts of money in the event their companies go under or disappear from the market completely.
paragraphs.cn: Genki将原因归于日本《支付服务法》。这项严格法律旨在保护消费者免受欺诈，要求数字代码销售商预留大笔资金，以应对公司倒闭或退出市场的情况。

paragraphs.en: To no one’s surprise, most corporations don’t want to hand the Japanese Government tons of cash for indefinite safekeeping. Lucky for them, there’s a way to circumvent this; if the product expires in less than six months, the rule doesn’t apply, which is why these GTA 6 codes have an expiration date of 170 days.
paragraphs.cn: 不出所料，多数公司不愿把大笔现金无限期交由日本政府保管。幸运的是有规避方式：若产品在六个月内到期，该规定便不适用，这就是《GTA6》代码设为170天有效期的原因。

paragraphs.en: Regardless of the intended financial protections, folks online aren’t too happy with this news, with one theorizing on X, “Guess they’ll need to refresh stock pretty regularly to avoid people buying an out-of-date code.”
paragraphs.cn: 无论其金融保护初衷如何，网友并不满意。一名X用户推测：「他们得经常更新库存，免得有人买到过期代码。」

paragraphs.en: “Yes, that or they don’t do anymore shipments after it is sold out,” Genki replied .
paragraphs.cn: Genki回复：「是的，或者售罄后他们就不再补货。」

paragraphs.en: Rockstar’s decision to push codes in lieu of a fully physical disc for GTA 6 was hot on the heels of Sony’s announcement that it will stop printing game discs as of January 2028, sparking a heated debate around digital ownership that hasn’t shown any signs of slowing down.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar决定用代码代替《GTA6》实体光盘，紧随索尼宣布将从2028年1月起停止生产游戏光盘之后，再次点燃了持续未歇的数字所有权争论。

paragraphs.en: In fact, nearly all of PlayStation’s recent social media posts have been inundated with angry comments from players protesting the platform’s controversial business move, with the latest trailer for Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil film getting flooded with jokes that the central character isn’t transporting an organ, but rather “the last physical game copy in existence.”
paragraphs.cn: 事实上，PlayStation近期几乎所有社交媒体帖文都被抗议这一争议商业决定的愤怒评论淹没。扎克·克雷格执导的《生化危机》电影最新预告下，也满是玩笑：主角运送的不是器官，而是「世上最后一份实体游戏副本」。

paragraphs.en: Players can’t help but fear that this signals a transition that will echo through the rest of the industry, leading to an all-digital future where games, movies, and more can be pulled at-will, despite consumers having paid for them.
paragraphs.cn: 玩家不免担心这预示着整个行业的转型：未来全面数字化，尽管消费者已经付费，游戏、电影等内容仍可能被随时下架。

paragraphs.en: Protesters are even suggesting a full PlayStation blackout , urging players not to use Sony’s services from August 23 - 30 as a way of showing the company they mean business. Whether or not it’ll actually happen, or prove effective, remains to be seen.
paragraphs.cn: 抗议者甚至建议全面抵制PlayStation，呼吁玩家在8月23日至30日不使用索尼服务，以表明态度。此举会否发生或奏效，仍有待观察。

summary: 日本盒装《GTA6》并不含光盘，下载码若在发售后170天未兑换即会失效。原因是日本《支付服务法》的预付支付规定，玩家担忧这会加速实体版消失。
opus_summary: 盒装不等于实体拥有：日本《GTA6》下载码设170天期限，暴露出数字发行时代消费者对内容所有权的焦虑，也让实体收藏的意义再受质疑。
